pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions on the flank exhibit sharp pixel gradients at boundaries. The upper neck region shows a loss of discrete patch geometry, replaced by a continuous, highly textured dark mass.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative space forming an interconnected grid on the lower flank. Continuity of these pathways is broken in the neck and shoulder regions by extensive dark-pixel clusters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous line of low-amplitude vertical pixel protrusions along the upper neck, defining a jagged mane silhouette.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Large-scale textural disruption and dark-pixel hyper-pigmentation across the dorsal ridge and lateral neck, manifesting as a raised, irregular mass.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized dark, circular cluster of pixels on the mid-ventral flank indicates a discrete lesion or mark.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal mass on the neck possesses a distinct rugose texture, creating a three-dimensional depth effect in the pixel data compared to the flat pelage.
